RCA-CRT-002.note: Judged from the run's own screen captures: with default_event_type switched to rfq, the event-type chip on the single-stage create screen read "RFQ" in every capture from the moment the screen opened (01-open_create, 02-set_title, 04-expect_value); with the company's own "rfi" it read "RFP". The create screen follows the configured default; the automated check misread the title field.

RCA-EVT-016.note: Not the ticket's crash (that was a 500 in the activity formatter). Here the Activity drawer's request answered 200 with an empty list after a saved extension, so the backend logged no activity for the stage. Someone should decide whether an extension must appear in Order Activity.

RCA-BID-010.note: The vendor's first bid (120) was placed from the supplier portal and Master QCS showed it; a revised bid needs a 'revise bid' control the vocabulary does not have yet, so the revision was never submitted. The ticket's claim (one active bid at the latest price) was not tested.

RCA-EVT-027.note: The award waits for another user's approval; only the pending approver sees Approve, and this run has no other identity. Needs an approver login (otherIdentities) to finish.

RCA-QCS-023B.note: use_rank_l1_for_savings is a hidden setting (backend error 1103 for a company account); only a Procol-employee account can switch it. Run on a company already set up that way.
